verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.databricks.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index titled "Databricks Documentation" covering the Data Intelligence Platform. An agent can therefore be pointed directly at an agent-oriented entry point to the docs. Missing for 10: evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt or per-page markdown variants, first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/agent-docs offering, and independent corroboration of its depth or usefulness to agents.
